subject: maths
question: If a sum of ₹6,70,000 is invested for a year at 2% per annum compounded half yearly, then find the compound interest.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹6,70,000

Rate of Interest (r) = 2% per annum compounded half-yearly

Time (t) = 1 year

**Formula used:**

Compound Interest (CI) = A - P

Where, A = P(1 + r/n)ⁿt

n = number of times interest is compounded per year

**Calculation:**

n = 2 (half-yearly compounding)

Rate per half year = r/n = 2/2 = 1%

Time in half years = n × t = 2 × 1 = 2

A = 6,70,000(1 + 1/100)²

⇒ A = 6,70,000(1 + 0.01)²

⇒ A = 6,70,000(1.01)²

⇒ A = 6,70,000 × 1.0201

⇒ A = ₹6,83,467

CI = A - P

⇒ CI = 6,83,467 - 6,70,000

⇒ CI = ₹13,467

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**
